'''Twizzee''' was a nature spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who befriended lonely children, but could not be seen by adults. "Twizzee" was a popular name given to female Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Twizzee was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
